page.title: 1/2/25 The One Where We Convalesce at the Waterfall Fortress

revision.text:
[[File:Screenshot 2025-08-05 at 7.34.10 PM.png|thumb]]
== What Do We Do? == We’re still journeying, and need to decide our next step. We still need to do our exhaustion saving throws, and some of us are in rough shape.
We’ve crested a hill and we have a view of the city. There’s a rocky crag at the southern end that has a few raised towers. The river flows past it on the opposite side. From where we are, the bridge enters the walls. We could cut north of the city through the rolling fields, or make our way up through some rockier mountains to the south and drop down stream from the city.,
Is it a town/city/castle? When we think about the settlements that any of us have seen, Balz is the only one who has seen a big walled “city” with thousands of inhabitants. Monsoth was a couple thousand, not walled, wooden, not medieval London. This is smaller than Trenewydth, 150 people, 3-5 acres, but completely walled. We could probably find boarding but probably not a huge market. Similar in size to Meander (the fishing village on the river) Balz could say that it looks like a defensive castle. Big curtain wall with towers spaced along edges.
Krambler looks through the telescope. Nothing indicates the SK. The insignia shows a sky blue, not red and gold.
What direction was the squad of SK soldiers going when we ran into them? We couldn’t really tell at the time. We had to move slowly and didn’t have a chance to observe.
We decide to go to the city and find lodging. We’ll try to lay low. We may have to figure out a plan for Arthen.
== Our Arrival at the Fortress Taymar == Single cart path to a [[wikipedia:Barbican|barbican]]. Stone outcrop rising up to a tower. Towers are all connected. Wall climbs up the stone. One cluster overlooks everything else.
We head to the main entrance so as to not look shady. There are guards, both men and women. They’re watching us, but not super concerned with our approach. There’s some traffic on the road, not passing people now, but there’s dust in the distance.
We approach. There’s a portcullis. Four guards, two men, two women. All dressed in blue. Not heavily armored. We see an insignia of a silver harp on a blue background.
“Hello, travellers, what brings you to Taymar?”
We’d like to rest, we are weary, and discover more about your city.
As visitors, you are welcome, but until we have some idea of who you are, you need to leave any weapons or musical instruments with us. You will get them back, but they need to be left for Lord Black Willum and Lady Fiona.
(Branwen’s weapon lets her “call it at will,” which would amount to hiding it.) Do we want to smuggle it in?
Storr tries to sense what Kleghein is feeling. She’s affronted at being left at the gate.
It seems to all of us though that leaving weapons is SOP, it’s not aggressive or crazy.
They are watching the bear, but they need to get through official matters first. They take our things. As we’re going in they ask Silas, “This animal seems calm. Is he safe?”
“He is well trained.” (persuasion, 16) They are persuaded.
Bill and the raven are okay to enter.
We enter. The path is about 10 feet across. There are buildings on either side, wooden beams and plaster style. Immediately inside there is a four way intersection.
Storr asks about an inn and food.
You’d have to go towards the barracks, straight through to the far gate. We go that direction. We come to another portcullis with a couple other guards.
They say they do have some space. When travelers do arrive, we are able to provide space, but we need to know a little more about your business and where you’re coming from. We are a fortress, not a town, so there’s no inn per se. We may ask you to do a little work for us.
Br: What is the purpose of the fortress?
We maintain the bridge and watch the river
What are you watching for?
The river goes over a giant fall about ½ a mile downstream, so ew’re here to protect this entrance to Nyth.
What’s on the other side of the bridge?
A similar “rival” installation. Mostly just stealing some banners, etc.
K is looking for a large bell, but doesn’t see one yet.
Br: Never seen the waterfall. We’d love to get a closer look in the morning.
You can see the mist from the bridge, but a closer look is going to be too dangerous.
They’re waiting for us to tell them our story.
We decide to keep it simple, and say we are travelers and not from Nyth and are trying to get back home.
Not from Nyth? How did you get here? (Professional pushback, because we got in and they’re watching the river.)
We tell a tale, a hybrid of our story and Musk's story. They see that we are banged up, take some pity on us. Ya'll look like you could use some rest. We'd like to help you out. Come on into the guard house, get cleaned up, have something to eat, we'll get you some bunks.
We agree.
We are led up to the barracks. It's late afternoon. We end the journey. Fatigue Saving Throws coming up…
We all take multiple levels except for Krambler.
== The Night Sounds and the Guard Interrogation == We crash for the night. We take a short rest. As we listen to the river rushing by and the wind in the tight cleft in the mountains. Not sure where the wind is coming from, eerie tonal sounds, ethereal, in a minor key. More noticeable at night. Can still hear it in the morning, but more faint.
They offer us some hearty porridge for breakfast. A young page dressed in the guard livery asks how we all are. The lord and lady have been informed of our presences and are willing to speak to us if we are interested. They have heard that we have come from away and would like to hear more of your story and how we got here.
We decide to go see the lord and lady.
The guard master says it’s been a longtime since we’ve hosted anyone outside of Nyth. She says, “We’ve heard that there are forces around. After a long time of not having incursions, we have to be on guard more so than in the past. How did you get here? Do you know how the SK arrived?”
Storr: We come from Norglass, which is unfamiliar to anyone here, just as we are unfamiliar with Nyth. We’re trying to avoid the SK minions.
How do you get from there to here?
We went through a cave in our world and emerged in Nyth.
We’ve heard tell of other lands. Are they real? We know the water falls. No one we know has gone over and returned. We don’t know where it goes. Presumably something could back from that place. We don’t know where that place is.
We’ve been told that the waterfall would bring us back home, we don’t know how.
Do you know what would be on the other side? Who told you about the waterfall? You trust them if they told you to jump over a waterfall?
It’s been a long time, we’re tired and desperate, trying to get home.
So you’re going to die?
Silas offers that they had found his sister, whom he trusts, in Nyth after they had been separated as children, and she was the one to suggest that we seek out this waterfall to bring us home.
They decide that perhaps they’ve gotten as much information as they could from us.
Black Willem and Fiona should hear this, when you are ready. It'd be cool if you lot could pull your weight a bit around here and do some chores…
Do you know if you’re being pursued by SK? Did they come through looking for you? Is there a connection?
We’ve avoided them so far. We don’t know what their intentions are.
You seem peaceable, as far as we know, you didn’t get up to anything last night. How long do you anticipate being here if we need to ask something of you? Anything to offer in terms of skills for us to utilize?
K is in good shape.
You can stay for a few days, but on condition that we will go and sit down and speak with them. Is anyone willing to take on a task? K is willing, and has experience hammering and making shit. She sends K over to some artisan shops.
== Krambler Helps the Fortress Artisans == Someone is building wooden boxes with strings with bridges. Someone else is building trumpet looking things with animal heads at the end. Ask if he’s willing to help. K rolls 2 d20s (26). This is his insight into what they were working on. He spends the day, they’re building instruments it would seem. These folks are masterful in terms of their craft. They are humming quietly to themselves, what they’re doing is imbuing the instruments with some sort of power.
Our first full day in Taymar is complete.
What do we do for the next couple of days? Others lay around for a couple days shedding exhaustion while krambler continues his shopping.
K: Why are they making these instruments and who are they for?
We hope that we do not need to blow these trumpets. They’re war trumpets, they patrol the bridge with them. If someone comes up over the chasm, this will be their first line of defence. Also making :war harps” They put them at the tops of the towers. The wind plays them and the guards can tell if something is amiss with the wind. These are the eerie sounds we heard in the night.
How do these protect you?
Their goal would be to strike fear into the hearts of any who approach.
3 full days have passed. Evening in Taymar. The rest of us have shed our exhaustion and can get up and move as a party.
== We Go to See the Lord and Lady == [[File:The_Fortress_Taymar_with_the_party_in_the_greenspace_of_Lord_Black_Willem_and_Lady_Fiona..png|thumb|The Fortress Taymar with the party in the greenspace of Lord Black Willem and Lady Fiona.]] We go to see the lord and lady.
There are trees growing in the space in this tower. There’s an old stone table. An old man that seems to have had reddish brown hair but now gray. Blue cloak. One eye is messed up, sort of lazy. A younger woman, an adult, she wears a long purple robe. They enter holding hands elegantly and come and sit down at the table. They ask us to sit. They offer us wine.
Br: Who are you?
We are the lord and lady, we run things.
St: Who are the people across the water?
They are younger siblings of ours. They have a similar task.
What is that task?
To watch the bridge and prevent anything from coming back over the waterfall.
Has anything ever come up from the waterfall?
No, we hear fell voices on the wind coming up out of the chasm and our understanding is that there may come a time when the world changes. And clearly it is changing with your presence and one of your sisters and an army. Certainly there are worse things than an army of humans can arrive here and out of the abyss. But perhaps its not an abyss if your world is at the bottom.
We were thinking about jumping over the edge. Are you all fine with that?
They’re intrigued, but doubtful and want to discourage us. How do you know it’s the right place? They’re hesitant about our assurance that everything will be fine.
We’re not sure, but this is what we’re trying. If you know of any other leads, we’ll listen.
They want to know how these connections between these worlds exist.
Sidebar: we don’t know why these connections exist. They seem to have more information than we did arriving here. They’re aware of the existence of two worlds. Perhaps we can talk about Gorg and Gwenethen and Mother Night, as those are figures we've heard in our own stories but have also come across folk in Nyth that know them.
We mention Gorg and Gwen, and Mother Night. They perk up at this. They ask if our travels have anything to do with those figures. K notices then that as they talk about the three of them, they’;re looking a little more intently at Branwen (Balz is being ignored for now.) They’re trying to see if we have any alignment with the names we just mentioned. And if our travel is connected.
Branwen expresses her unapologetic patronage to MN. The rest of us distance ourselves from this idea, with Silas saying that he holds no opposition to Branwen's alignment, but for himself he feels he may be more in tune with the ideals of Gwenethen.
Black Willum leans forward, smirking (see above), and asks “Do you fear the dead?”
Bran and Storr decidedly don’t (Br: "Some of my best friends are dead."). K and Silas are more hesitant to outright dismiss them.
They sing a sad song which we don’t necessarily understand. It’s appropriate to the beginning of autumn when thinking of those who had been lost reminding us that beautiful things can come out of loss. They say: "If perhaps you’re willing, we have something to potentially offer you. You can go over the waterfall, but you can go over with a guide of sorts, (Willum is smirking again) but it will take a certain level of bravery than simply jumping over in a barrel. It’s a dark journey."
== Next Time == The coming week. We’ll probably end up leaving Nyth next week and pausing Osgog.
# Consider their offer # Anything else we want to do # What next steps are

page.title: 1/8/26-4/28/26 All The Ones Where We Didn't Update the Wiki for Four Months

revision.text:
== Jan 8, 2026 The One Where We’re Set Upon by Some Boss Centaurs == Nathaniel talks about a change to the boat journeying. The mechanics there will change, because the levels of exhaustion upon arriving at a new place with little opportunity to do anything about doesn’t work very well. We all get to drop 2 levels of exhaustion.
We talk about character changes. Tom will be updating Storr’s page with backstory changes.
Nathaniel shares some changes on how Silas’ cloak works, and how Seren also had one of the arctic fox flavor (more details tbd)
We recap last time.
We’ve not left the boat yet, and given the new exhaustion levels, we’re all going to check out the shore. We take all our stuff.
We don’t hear the noises anymore. The terrain is ocean-smoothed cobble, smooth otherwise. We do see tracks, large 6in across where more visible, circular-ish indentations where something was moving around. They appear to move up into the forest.
Storr: These could be centaurs, like the sentries.
Silas is our tracker (Nature, 18). Silas leads with Arthen and Storr behind. We track most of the morning. Goes through some dense forest. Guessing that its hoof prints. Eventually it peters out, forest grows back in around it. As time goes on, they grow less distinct. Not sure what to make of it. Silas says it looks horse-ish. There are multiple animals. At least 3, but not totally sure. Could be more but probably not less.
It does seem we are following the tracks in the same direction they were traveling. Silas does notice that the tracks should be fresher here but they’re not, which seems strange, like the forest is involved. The forest does seem primeval.
We’ve been moving up hill inside a cull. We’re reaching up toward a high spot between two hills.
Storr posits that these folks probably know we’re here, saw us on the boat. We probably shouldn’t try and sneak up on them. May not be a threat, but they may also be a threat. We agree to proceed cautiosly, but not sneak around, and attempt to be unaggressive. We head to the high hill.
Krambler is our pathfinder tonight (Travel: 6) We get turned around and don’t totally know where we end up.
We find ourselves in a clear with a little outcropping (screenshot) We move into the circle, and start to hear rustling in the bushes to the northeast southwest and northwest of us.
Storr scrambles onto a boulder to get a better look. She hears the twang of a bow, and sees a creature emerge, a centaur. (She missed.)
WE FIGHT
* Krambler hits for a CRIT HIT * The centaurs so far have been whiffing like their little hooves depended on it. * The mage centaur has a sword and can do like 3 things in one turn. * Silas gets hit BAD and drops to zero, automatically bearing out * Branwen takes out Gale and sing a song (Brid song) and Branwen is surrounded in a purple aura of ravens. The centaur encompassed in the aura is now frightened of her. * Krambler falls. Branwen falls. Silas in bear form gets down to 1. * Storr uses the INFLUENCE action to convince the mage that they don’t want to fight. * Silas as the bear, hears Storr’s plea, and places his staff on the ground
COMBAT ENDS
The mage picks up K and stabilizes his fallen centaur, then stbailizes K and Bran, then comes back to stand atop the outcropping, and the other centaurs make their way up next to him. The mage stares down at storr to see what we do next.
Storr moves up into the outcropping and kneels. The mage speaks in a not-common language, a bit like what Myrthen used.
Storr casts speak with animals. As the spell takes effect,. He makes the same sounds again and looks at storr and says “what of your companions?”
St motions to them to join her. We gather.
To Storr: “Why re you here? Why are you following into this forest
Centaur: While you may come to this island, the forest and the peaks are not for you. I suggest you return to the ship. If you intend to speak to the others, that’s on you.
Who are the others?
The three women who live below the tree.
S: We will gladly leave. Would you be willing to tell us where to find the tree?
Cen: Look for the shadow in the sky. (He feels confident that that will help you find the way.)
Storr thanks him “we will do as you request. My weapon and i are bonded. Would you return it to me?
(Yes, but Nathaniel’s going to think about it for the week.)
== Jan 15, 2026 The One Where We Leave The Boss Centaurs And Make for the World Tree == We recap last weekend.
Storr and Silas talk about changes to their past.
These four are half horse, centaurish. But they vary in how human they are.
Where are these women? What do you think of them?
Look for the shadow of the giant tree. We guard this forest and like to be aware of those who approach the well.
Is the well in this growth?
The well is ast the base of the tree
Is the tree drinking from the well
You could say such things.
We draw the cradle. He sees it as a symbol of unity of the world.
Is tehre a connection between the symbol and the three women?
You’re asking deep questions. We have suspicions but we don’t know.
What is significant about the landmass?
….
Did we do anything to make you think we’re enemies?
You came to a place you’re not supposed to be.
We didn’t know that. But you’re comfortable with us going to the tree?
'''Visitors can go there as long as we mark your passage'''.
The forest is very rich and alive. It feels otherworldly. They are protecting the forest.
We turn to go. He points at Balz: and says to storr, “What is this one? How is he made? How is he here?”
Silas regales them
He gives Balz a look as though he was welcome to approach. Sizing up Balz, thinking.
He points at Balz’s broken horn, asking for it. He holds it, understanding passes between the other centaurs. He indicates the horn and looks to Balz questioningly.
Balz explains what it’s capable of, and asks if that function will cease if it gets mended.
He hands Balz back the horn and reaches out to Balz’z forehead. '''With B’s consent, he draws a line down his forehead. B feels a bit of energy, a positive feeling. Odd. Not quite sure what to make of it. Balz would feel marked.''' The leader seems satisfied and says something to the other centaurs and they all walk off into the woods.
We travel back the way we came to the beach.
The centaurs were saying something about the tree having a shadow in the sky.
We heal, and short rest.
Balz awakens in the night and spies the shadow of an enormous tree extending into the sky. We’re reminded of the tree that we fell through jumping out of nyth. Took up a lot most of the sky. Branwen has a weird memory like she’s seen this tree before but she can’t remember where.
We wake. Balz and Storr check out the waterfall. (investigation, 6 & 8 respectively)
Branwen sends Koweth, Silas sends Arthen with him so he can practice tracking. Koweth does a loop around flies off to the waterfall. Earthen ranged along the beach, sniffing around teh animal trail. Koweth called, Arthen disappeared into the brush. They both came back after a bit indicating that if we followed them we’d have a way forward. The animals high five each other (wing to ear, really).
We travel with the help fo A&K up and around the waterfall. There are a set of rough stairs off the end of what we thought was an animal trail. Balz has a weird sense as he’s gong along that he recognizes this as a human trail, but he doesn’t know why he knows that. Feels different than the forest. We emerge.
The river is flowing out of the hill. A few inches deep, larger pools maybe waist deep, a mountain stream flowing downhill.
We wade into this cave. Bran and Silas take spills.
We emerge.
The tree to the left is gigantic. We’re surrounded by craggy walls of stone. The sky appears to be dusk. We see three women hanging out. They acknowledge us, but standing very still around the water, watching.
One looks remarkably like if Storr and Branwen had a baby. Storr hits on Branwen, Branwen kind of returns the favor, but says she doesn’t want it.
We pause for the evening.
N. requests that we give him a one-liner speaking to the direction our character is going at the moment, what they’re looking for, want most.
== Jan 22, 2026 The One Where We Chat With Thee Women By A Pool, But It’s 2026 == The 3 lost their names long ago. Not sure who took them. A man remembers though. Osgog remembers!
We were put here and left. Spoken only of whispers.
We hear ourselves on the winds, sometimes.
They once had power beyond your reckoning.
The stories are no longer told, it's hard to remember that power that used to flow through us.
We tell a tale of The God King. After a bit of rolling…
They feel themselves in that story.
Is this the prison from the story?
Black hair: we seem to be stuck here.
Old woman: it's a prison because we ''don't have our names''!
Branwen presents Gale, telling them that the sword contains the storm itself. They toss the sword around, the older woman sticks Gale into stone.
Branwen asks if they recognize the storm within. No super clear response.
Storr asks if they know Rhiannon - it was her sword. We don't peddle in petty names like those.
B asks if they know Bremfyr, he crafted it. We aren't impressed by this trinket, I've crafted far more impressive.
What do you want?
Balz has been marked by the spirits of the forest
We can tell you your: Past(white) present(red) future(black)
Balz asks the future lady. You seem to have a gift to receive. It may be helpful to look forward instead of backward. Pointing at the horn. You have a choice: paths of the bones we made, or back to the humans. Take the horn. Drink from the well.
Balz decides humans suck. Redhead: how do you feel about becoming a wild thing? Balz likes his wits, doesn't want to be a beast.
Black hair: this gift on the way to youm but you can taste the flavor. Would you rather …beasts of the forest or go back to some version of yourself?
Balz wants to do it. Whatever it is.
Balz chooses beast mode.
He drinks from the well, using his horn. He feels the water coursing through his veins. He feels ALL of his parts. Intimately. He feels his body as primordial pieces (skin:bark, blood:sea water, etc).
Balz can cast Alter self (<nowiki>https://roll20.net/compendium/dnd5e/Alter%20Self#content</nowiki>) as a 2nd level ritual spell.
These 3 are close to him, and have something to do with what he is made of.
White hair looks at Branwen. Says: your past is lost, is it not?
'''Balthazar’s Input:'''
'''They ask Branwen what she would give the three if they gave them back her past.'''
'''Black Hair: Who’s playing the music and where did it come from'''
'''Bran: From the Boatman, it was Cricket’s song. I have odd connections to Cricket, our essences are somehow entwined. His loss became my being.'''
'''White Hair: You have three things, and perhaps an arrangement can be made. I would take a flute of bone–'''
'''Red Hair: And I would take a perpetual fire–'''
'''Black: And I would take a cloak that hides in the darkness'''
'''Bran: And in return you’d tell me my past?'''
'''A pause indicating a yes.'''
'''Branwen considers: she’d have to give up her prized items (one thing to one of them). She gives the Redhead the everburning fire.'''
'''The Redhead blows it into flame, and the Three look upon it and the woman with white hair says, And I believe you have some flower petals? Branwen casts them into the fire.'''
'''The Black Haired woman spins her hand as the petals turn to ash in the flames, or are pushed away. They look at the pool and tell Branwen to drink from it.'''
'''Branwen glances at Storr looking for affirmation, Storr provides. Silas, too. Branwen drinks some water with her hands. The following occurs:'''
'''Everything goes fuzzy for Branwen. Her eyes are open, but she isn’t seeing what’s around her. She experiences feeling herself suddenly in a greyscale world, and slowly realizing she’s on a boat, a small boat, rocking on a black sea. As she feels the boat move on the waves, she sees the shore come in and out of focus, far away. She feels a lot of pain in her throat, and finds she is drenched in blood. A familiar voice says from behind, This is the land you now inhabit.'''
'''The boat runs aground and Branwen steps out. She sees the Boatman and recognizes him. Memories flood back, and she recognizes herself as Cricket. She undergoes the same process that caused her to undergo her original transformation, and emerges, still Branwen, but with all of Cricket’s memories and the certain knowledge that it was the Boatman that carried her across the water. She finds herself back at the edge of the pool.'''
'''''Storr’s Take…'''''
A man may know the three names… his name is Osgog and he remembers all things. They were put there and forgotten about, spoken about only in whispers and hear themselves on the wind sometimes.
They can feel themselves flowing.
Silas:
The tree: it doesn’t look identical to any of the trees we’ve seen. But there would be a strong kinship between those other tress adn at least possible that it was a manifestation or an aspect of one tre that is casting this shadow. The shadow would lead silas to believe we saw a part of a tree or part of it.
== Jan 29, 2026 The One Where We Contemplate Helping the Enchantresses == We discuss Balz’ horn, drinking from it, how the Abbot drank from a horn in the tree before he died.
We discuss what to do next. We decide to go back into the cave and try to travel to the tree through the pool.
We go back to the pool and the women are still there.
Balz looks through the spyglass at the water and thinks he sees the reflection of stars, even though its day.
Storr asks what they see, and they render Storr unconscious.
Balz asks if we can make a deal. If we get their names back, what would their intentions be?
White hair: I would like to feel the power in my hands again
Read hair: I once felt power coursing through my body, but now i am here, and i would like to find those who took it from me
Black hair: There was a time when I rode high amongst the winds and could travel throughout the world and I would like that freedom back.
Silas asks the young one about her travels. I no longer remember my travels, but if i had my name back…I would know.
Branwen last week got the sense that her patron saw that they could be powerful allies but also cause a LOT of trouble.
Balz asked about their history, and got silenced by the white hair.
Branwen: we cant very well go around asking about the names of 3 strange ladies. What do you remember about yourselves that could aid us in finding your names?
R: We told you we heard of someone
B: And we told you his name–
W: Is '''''osgog'''''
We discuss osgog and his mother (doldhelan/Noswaith), and Osgog and the Dragon.
Silas’s note: There is a sisterhood of Doldhelan and Ceridwen (kelynnyn, Gwen at the tower, probably Seren. If Osgog’s mother is truly still trapped, we would have an interest in freeing her. If these three have their names back, maybe they could help free her.
Ok, big theories coming together.
Osgog's mother is imprisoned, presumably by Mons (Osgog and the Dragon). Osgog built a dragon, a nameless entity that could penetrate the barrier and free his mother.
The dragon ends up defeated and left encircling the mother's grove/prison thing.
The compass has a dragon wrapped around a 5 lobed cradle-figure.
Balz' dream has a dragon wrapped around some entity.
The 3 women's names may have been taken by Gorgomog.
Osgog remembers the 3's names, according to the 3, themselves.
Storr posits the compass is symbol of her failure.
Silas’ note: Osgog and the Dragon seems to be written with a certain angle, read: propaganda of Mons. The cradle, if a symbol of Noswaith, could have positive connotations, as a sign of honor and respect put out into the world by the sisterhood.
The cradle: We talk about the girls at the tower playing teh game with Arthen (it was the not=glasses girl three.
We play the game in front of the thre women. Black hari taps Balz on the shoulder and indicates he should be in the center with Arthen.
The women close their eyes and nod, looking satisfied.
Bran: Do you want to try?
Red: No, but somehow it does bring me comfort.
== Feb 5, 2026 == Silas’ notes
The well water is not for us, it’s for them. We’ll not be traveling through this pool. They say we need to become familiar with the path and what it wants.
The react negatively to the black water, but they don’t know anything about it.
How do we find out what the road wants?
Black hair: When something feels that you’re looking to get something from it rather than hearing what it itself is interested in, it tends not to listen to your request. Perhaps this is a place where listening harder to the things will create a greater friendship than making demands with them.
Seren perhaps reached this understanding with the road to be able to travel along these pathways.
We get the sense that the shadow of this tree is also cast by the pool tree.
Balz plays Awel. They step toward the water. There’s a swirl of black and of wind.
Balz: what does it mean to you?
Black hair: I feel it in my bones.
Silas plays Melys. They step forward with their arms out. A warm glow emanates from the pool. They seem warmer and more motherly, less hard than before.
Balz: Rew. They stand taller. The glow turns to harsh colorless white. They look stern, not frightening, but rigid.
We see that there was a level of their reaction that was not voluntary. Not quite conditioned response. They were swept up in it. They seemed pressed toward something. Almost like a fairground whistle where people snap to attention out of habit. They dont loose consciousness, they’re moved to do this. There’s a little relief in them that they’ve accurately performed their duties, don’t mind the routine sort of thing.
Are the songs older than the enchantresses themselves?
In the evening, Silas and Arthen head into the woods for a hunting training session
Branwen hums the bird song
== Feb 12, 2026 ==
Silas notes:
The journey:
Balz: Guide (Travel)
Storr: Hunter
Silas: Scout (Exploration)
Branwen: Lookout (perception)
Event 1:
Balz (5), 1 day
Silas(10) and Arthen are hanging out on the bow. We’re traveling through a cloud bank and the wind picks up, and it blows the bank out. It’s late at end of Day 2. The cloud whisks back, in one direction we see a beautiful sunset on one side, but we turn and see the full moon behind us as the second night begins. Silas beckons everyone up to the deck. We all have a moment of these elements, the ocean, the cloud, the sun and moon, where its a deep mystical feeling.
Event 2:
Balz (23), we arrive.
Desolate mound, small, a few hundred meters across. Huge slabs of rock stuck into the ground. The ring is 50 yards wide.
Slabs are a foot or a foot and a half thick. 6 to 10 feet wide. 10-15 feet tall, some 20. We get closer and see that there is a ditch that goes down to a flat space. There’s a relatively flat stone in the middle, level with the turf. Can confirm there are 12 upright stones.
Arthyden and Storr and Arthen move to the center. They see passageways behind these doors and maybe they’re closed doors. We seem to be at a crossroads, but we can’t seem to find a way out.
== 2/26/2026 == Storr thoughts -
* 12 stone henges we’ve seen this pattern before ** Merthyn circle for example ** Tree island stones circling that played music ** Maybe we have to interact with them ** Storr examines one slab, the two faces are parallel - the sides look like book pages; *** It’s thinnest at the bottom and 12 feet tall *** Grey w/ crust and liken, very old looking *** May be we have to play music FOR the stones, not from the stones? *** Branden Hopps is a fine young man *** We are going to form the cradle with our arms, put Arthen in the middle, and sing a song together *** Storr thinks our intention has to be to sing a song that connects to a particular place (Silas song for example may open a path way to some place associated with druidism) **** Our performance rolls were terrible (10 Storr, 1, and 6)
WE RECALL BEING TOLD THERE WAS AN INSIGHT ROLE THAT WE DON’T HAVE ENOUGH INFORMATION TO DO ANYTHING HERE… forty five minutes ago. Hoppsy was very patient with Silas and Storr; he deserves recognition for that.
WE '''''journey'''''! Nate rolls a 20 for the weather - JOYFUL SIGHT - wafting mist, seafog, wind picks up an we start cruising along at a good clip. Night falls. Fog opens up… we are unsure how long we've been going - could be while, could be short, no sunrise though. Seems great. Fog parts to reveal an island. The height of the island has 2 peaks. Crescent moon horns are sitting atop the hill. We are all moved and inspired by this event. (we all get an extra d20 to downtime activity, in the next 24 hours).
<Oh what a night - Billy Joel.gif>
Wafting mist, seafoam, the wind picks up behind us, and we’re moving at a good clip, it’s exhilerating. Nigh t falls. We’re in the fog, and then it opens. We’re not suire how long we’ve been sailing. It feels like it’s been a while, but at the same time there hasn’t been a siunrise. Felt really good. We see an island rising in front of us. Very dramatic, after the The height of it – the island has two peaks on it. Quite close to this island. Over the peak is a super thin crescent moon that reminds of horns siting on the hill,. Like tthe hill has horns. We are all moved, and inspired. Extra d20 for a downtime activity in the next 24 hours.
We stay on the boat over night. Storr is EXHAUSTED from this amazing journey. We smell rain on the air. We slept and rest, but IT'S STILL NIGHT TIME.
We ain't scared. Storr leads a charge up to the beach (with Kleghein in one hand and Krammer in the other, howling with madness).
The branches sway up high in the wind.
We climb that fucking hill. (Kate Bush ensues)
We blast Immigrant song on soundshare
“Come on you fools, do you want to live forever? There’s a hill to climb!”
Silas and Arhten have an Aragorn-Gimli moment like Silas is about to toss Arthen up the hill.
We blast Running up that Hill on soundshare.
We find a GIANT figure on the top of the hill.
== Mar 5, 2026 == Balz reads the log from last week.
WE FIGHT
# The giant blasts the group of us with a bolt and we loose a bunch of health despite rolling really well. Arthen collapses into the woods. Silas bears out. # Storr implstorrs Arthyden to let her ride. Some quick calculations given the terrain reveals that the travel required probably wouldn’t be worth it. Next time. # Branwen ravens out, flies up, and frightens the shit out of the giant # Balz pulls a real Hawkeye and blasts this mother with some high quality crossbow hits. # Storr uses Kleghien and her runes to great effect # The giant brings down a huge lightning bolt down on the group for significant damage. Branwen starts gurgling blood. # Silas brings down the (claw) hammer on the giant and he collapses, holding his groin. A wind blasts through the area toward the north east. It seems like it’s dissipating as it goes, but we can’t really see it as it travels through the darkness. We hear fell voices on the wind as the shadow shape gets blown off the hilltop into the night sky.
Balz rolls old lore in an attempt to glean what we hear. DM will let us know what we hear.
We’re not totally sure what this precipice was built for, it’s a natural hilltop with human intervention.. Some of the island is hidden by the surrounding slopes.
We think the moon HAS moved, no longer in the same direction from us, but it hasn’t changed it’s elevation, just seems to be circling around the island. Perpetually shining down on the island.
We take downtime activities x2 (joyous sight), and take a short rest.
There’s wind. Branwen casts comprehend languages. DM will get abc to us about that too.
== Mar 19, 2026 == Balz as the storm giant dissipates: Reminds balz of the youngest enchantress somehow, but like a son, or a male.
Branwen’s listening (comprehend languages):
In terms of comprehend languages from the end of Thursday night, you think that the voices on the wind are almost like a fractured personality, it[s almost the babble of a confused mind talking to itself. They’re searching for something - they keep saying “it” - but it’s as though they’re talking to themselves/each other, and the wind is weaving in and out of the world looking for whatever this thing is.
Balz may want to…
Weave the wind, with the voices on the wind and all.
Silas rolls 17 investigation. Nothing seems to be off to the northeast where the giant wind went. Guessing though that the smaller hilltop is also bald.
We head over to the other little hill on the island. Branwen leads the party over with her Darkvision. Arthen is sent on a mission up the hill, while listening to the "epic" version of the Kate Bush song. He is gone for like 15 minutes, and nothing really comes of it.
We come to a rise, with standing stones and swirling patterns (screenshot). It's misty, wind flowing through.
There’s scree on the ground in swirling patterns. Branwen turns into a raven and flies to the top of the tallest stone. Someone appears. She (Jessie Buckley) looks at the raven, and tilts her head.
Bran thinks perhaps Jessie Buckley is maybe part of the sisterhood, the “crag and forest” group.
Branwen reforms into … Branwen, and hums Cricket's lullaby. Jessie Buckley comes around the corner.
There's various rock investigations. Old rock. Lichen.Textures as the air flows, air is feeling the rock as it flows.
Branwen: "Seems like you know this song better than i"
Woman (JB): Holds up a hand and starts waving her hands. Branwen fails a CON save, and gets drowsy.
Branwen cries out and we hear it.
Silas approaches, and becomes relaxed, but not drowsy. Storr also approaches and become relaxed.
Silas hails her, and asks what she’s doing here.
She asks what WE’RE doing here. She likes the song.
Branwen tries to wake up, by singing Melys. She feels a warmth. She can stand up and feel more awake.Branwen defiantly, confidently sends a look of "I see your song, and here is another".
Silas smokes, and asks what she knows of the power of this place. She bends and picks up some greenery on the ground
“There can you smell that?”She hips the herb in her hand in front of us. Silas and Storr inhale deeply. Storr finds it calming. Silas recognizes it as a scent (thyme)
“As for the power, I think this is one of those things… what I am trying to do here has very little to do with ords, so its hard ot explain. If you relax and let it come to you, you can rather see what I mean.”
Silas: Are there others here with you?
JB: I think so, but I’m never really sure.
We let the woman use the quill to no real avail, but she tried.
Discussion of how the party has ALWAYS under-counted the events at the tower when a shadow escaped and we got a quill.
== Mar 26, 2026 == Attention turns to Silas.
Silas puffs his pipe, "Delightful, that smell. Do you use that in your cooking".
JB: Depends on the the cooking. I'm always trying to SHAPE THE AIR. Sometimes the scents you put on it help shape it. You use what ingredients you can find.
S: I too come from the outdoors.
JB: There's so much here. That's why I come here, and others.
S: So you're a visitor here?
JB: We are all visitors - I choose to stay here at this spot.
S: look at the ground !
JB: yes, you can see where the air has shaped the ground.
We recognize the Cradle as part of the scree pattern.
S: We've seen this before. From my childhood, even.
JB: HmmMmm, but feeling the wind and not listening to us a lot. This is a good, central spot -
AND WE NOTICE A FUCKING CRADLE IN THE STONES UNDER HER
Silas proposes that we do the Cradle game with JB in the center of the circle while standing over the symbol.
JB: You can call me Gwynys.
So we cradle. She declines to sing, prefers to listen to the wind.
There’s a constant breeze. She’s moving her hands, cupping them, opening her mouth, experimenting. We hear notes. It sounds like Merthyn's Cradle Song - it was produced by Gwynys and the wind.
JB: Creation is what it is . when you are making something you don't always know where the inspiration comes from.
I'm trying to write the wind. Sometimes it feels familiar, sometimes it don't. Not sure if I've written that one before. Inspiration comes and goes. It's not about me, but about writing the wind and letting it go into the world.
S: tells of the wind weavers, baskets, etc.
JB: The wind goes everywhere, finds it's way between and all over. It finds its way. You can feel it move, but can't understand it entirely, just making it as beautiful as I can.
S: What's you goal with the wind here?
JB: The movement is the goal, sometimes it comes out and you think, that was pretty special.
S: You harness so beautifully…hey, you know about the storm giant we ran across? We had to defend ourselves….
JB: Don't know, but the wind is powerful. It has a strength, a personality, can be destructive.
Branwen: asks if JB can teach her to harness the wind in this way
Old lore roll (21). She teaches her. It’s a melancholy movement. She’s moving her hands, picking up the herbs, she talks B through it and B tries to do the same. JB: You do seem to have something of a knack for it. This is something you can clearly see and be a bit of a writer with the wind.
Bran: Why the word “Writing”?
JB: I feel as though that's the right word, I’m a '''wind poet'''. I think it’s more about writing a feeling. When you’re writing a poem, it's telling you something, it puts you into an emotional place. It’s the feeling. It’s the different pieces of it.
Branwen gets it.
JB: You said your family was involved?
Bran: I don’t know my family directly. But there women (Morianoth, Doldhelen) would try to hear and understand its sign. I have a connection to them.
JB: That first name: Morianoth, feels familiar and windlike somehow.
B: I don’t know as much about my background as much as I’d like, but you might know my mother, Mother Night. In different phases she’s listened to the wind. You might know her.
JB: I think perhaps I have maybe a temptation to offer you. (Also offers it to Balz in regard to weaving the wind).
She REACHINES INTO THE FOLDS OF HER DRESS AND PULLS OUT A SMALL CORKED GLAS BOTTLE WITH A PURPLE LIQUID IN IT. and says
This effects everyone differently, but at times I think I can see the wind differently even if it seems hazy and confusing. It’s quite strong, but if the two of you would like to rry it that has shown this interest, I would be willing to offer it to you.
They predator handshake. CON save (Bran: 16, Balz: 20)
Nathaniel will email.
== Apr 2, 2026 == Bran and Balz take swigs. Bran’s eyes roll back. Balz dematerializes like the guy fro the tower to a different spot.
She asks Bran: What did you see?
Bran: Everything.
During the process Bran did pull Gale out. She looks down at it wide eyed and is trying to hear if there’s a song. She remembers a song but can’t place it. Bran realizes Gale is sentient. Rules are similar to Kleg. She feels a song like vibration and understands that G feels a little bit less alone. Gwyn says “And who is that one then?” pointing at Gale.
Bran feels Gale and says, “Gale.”
JB: Can you feel it talking to you? I can feel she’s talking but I can’t understand it. She speaks in song though.
Bran is in sensory overload. Balz takes the spotlight.
Balz: Felt like I experienced hundreds of lifetimes. A crazy journey, very disorienting. What did I experience?
JB: I think only you can say what it is you experienced. This comes from a recipe I was told and I’ve it was called The Wine of Nightmares. I’ve heard of that before elsewhere and I’m not sure if this is truly that substance. But I could certainly believe that it was given the experience of drinking it.
Balz: I don’t regret it I just don’t understand it.
JB: Hard to say if any person really can.
We talk cradle.
We look up.
We see stars. Some of them look familiar. Some of them do not. It’s very dark except for the crescent moon. The moon has been circling us, not rising and setting. The stars are moving as expected.
Gwenis, does the sun ever come out on this island?
Nope, easier to see the wind at night time - makes the other senses stronger.
Br: WHO ARE YOU"?
I write the wind, I try to write the wind, anyway.
I'm here, why would I leave, since I can occupy the breeze at night.
Br: whe'red you get the wine?
Found it floating on the shoreline, a few bottles.
WINE OF NIGHTMARES - Nate really wants us to know the name of this drink.
Balz: he became disembodied, <insert balz vision>
Percep, 12: He’s capturing images and they’re coming fast, but in one moment he recognizes that people in general in this state, they are not aware of him, he’s moving around as the wind. There is a moment where eyes look directly at him. They see you and recognize you. You recognize them (you have seen them before but not sure where.)
Bran: <insert bran vision>
Bran has had visions of a dancing woman before (as Cricket)
We Journey
Same roles.
Balz: Travel: 8
We sail out to sea. Steady rain and wind. Feeling waterlogged but okay.
Fatigue saving throw +1. Next hunting roll has disadvantage
Event #1: Branwen
She directs us so well, that we’re fine. We’re not blown off course.
Balz: 6
Fatigue saving throw +2 total
Event #2: Bran
She gets cocky and distracted by Arthen’s antics. She realizes we’ve fallen off the wind quite a ways, she gets her bearings to right our direction, but a day and night has passed. Soggy in reality and temperament. We give her space.
Balz: 12
Event #3: Silas
Cloudy w drizzle. Hunkered down in the tarp. Bran tried to play a song to lift spirits.
FST doesn’t increase. Everyone despite the rain feels a little warth and sunshine, and it’s definitely not Arthen’s “fishy flatulence”
Balz: 21
We arrive. We see islands in the distance.
It’s Trenewydth
== Apr 9, 2026 == Nathaniel recounts the beginnings of osgog, and we chat more about the happenings before and after getting to the city, the Reb Blade, the gardeners, and the Sun King.
In character, we decide to backtrack the boat and try to find a place to shore up. We skirt around some large islands shaped like a pair of croissants with a small island in the middle. We decide to advance into the cove. We see some odd smoke coming from the island. Bran(percep, 22) sees some paths on the western ridge, but no settlement. Silas scouts (explore, 16) find s a decent spot to pull up to the western side.
We hike up to the ridge. Bran slips but handles it (dex 19)
Balz (CON, 16) wants to clear his mind and gets an inspiration. A nice vacay on a greek island reading Jack Gilbert.
Bran (old lore, 9) wants to scope evidence of the dead. None that she can see, but there’s something here and she doesn’t know what.
Storr (Hunting, 20) wants to find blueberries. She doesn’t find them, but she does find an olive grove. Arthen tries one and is delighted.
Silas (disadv, 5) wants to scope evidence of people. Can’t tell where smoke is coming from. It’s weird, just hanging out.
We scope the city from our outlook point. Can’t see into the city center.
We split up to rest. Balz stays at the outlook. Branwen stays at the midpoint. Silas goes south with Arthen to take a 24 hr rest to shed exhaustion. Storr heads down the slop and finds a suitable cave for stashing our things.
Balz hears with his ranger abilities that he feels like he’s being watched, hears animal sounds, but more like someone trying to make animal noises, signals.
Storr and Balz meet up with Bran around 10, then they head down to where Silas is, just before noon.
== Apr 16, 2026 The One Where We Meet Orm and Behold Her Frescoes == We’re curious about the night sounds. Balz (insight, 10): there are paths here, it would stand to follow those if we’re looking for people. (Balz, nature, 15) Bal’z impression was that there wasn’t communication, but that someone was checking us out and mask their movements by making natural movements.
Arthen seemed weary and watchful last night. Keeping watch over Silas.
Balz uses primeval awareness and feels some fey presence around (could be within 6 miles). Nothing too strong, some fey influence kicking around, otherworldly, based in nature-magic.
Bran becomes a raven and does a circuit around the island (Investigation, 18) There’s a network of opaths, seemingly random, but it does have an epicenter on the northwestern slope. Storr had found olive tress out that way. These seem like scavenging trails, gathering food, there’s a spring. A central spot. She focuses more and sees an entrance, some stonework hidden in some scrub, hovels, a cave. Looks like a manmade shelter-ish kind of thing.
Bran (travel, 18): we get there with no problems.
We elect Balz to be the face of the party. Bran ravens and alights in a tree. Silas and Arthen hang pack and couch down to seem less intimidating. Balz approaches with the olives and hails them. An eye peeks out from behind a cloth. He offers the olives. A pause. A woman steps out from behind the cloth dressed in well kept rags. Middle height, skinny but strong older woman. Hair pulled back.
What, you’re going to give me my own olives as a gift?
I can put them back.
No no I’m joking. You at least saved me the labor.
Balz: Come friends, nerf sit.
Bran flies down and materializes. She’s taken aback a little. They fist bump.
Silas: I have a bear.
Woman: I see that
Bran: He also is the bear
W: Perhaps I see that too.
Balz: Anything interesting happen lately?
W: A long awaited arrival and a subsequent departure
The city is always here, but there are other places that come to it.
W: I'm allowed to enter. It's a trade port first, and foremost.
Balz: who came and departed? I'll pay you in olives.
W: reaches into her pocket, pulls out a pipe. Watches him. The way you ask makes me think you know what I'm speaking of.
BZ: We don't know when or how of our last visit. Do you margaritas?
Who came and went, SUN KING, HMM?
W: NO! Someone much more interesting.
Balz: Who are you talking about?
Secret for a secret, she says.
BZ: tells tale of the Abbot.
The arrival was the Abbot and our accompaniment.
The body was claimed. I went in when i heard the news, but he had departed.
Silas: you just missed us!
W: possible.
He had departed by the time you got there, what did youmean.
His body was claimed.
The departure was him, along with whoever claimed him, leaving the city.
I wanted to see his body but it was no longer there. They seemed to think family had come and claimed him.
Bz: he has quite a family.
Shining prince? Prince of the world.
He returned and made a choice. That made all the different.
He didn't chose the crown, no one sits on the throne. Which sits far away. The sun king is trying to find th throne.
The foundling is the Abbot
Prophecy?
We recite the foundling poem. She thinks its interesting that the poem talks of a “she”. Balz offers that that’s like “glasses girl” and says we’ve found her. She promises to keep that information in confidence.
Silas sees some parallels of her to his own people. Lives in nature. Seems like she’s goot a handle on it.
We finally introduce ourselves. Her name is Orm.
We talk of the cradle, both the game and the symbol.
Orm: It seems rudimentary, but sometimes those types of symbols persist.
Balz: We’ve seen it also infused with color. Does that mean anything? (Balz: Persuasion, 19, after using inspo)
Orm: Come walk with me to the olive grove.
We follow. She walks up to aparticulatrly old tree. She puts her hand on it, looks to Bz and says, I don’t know what caused this tree to take this shape, or who planted it, but something or someone did. And Sometimes I look at the things here on the island and I am in awe of the patterns that they create, I don’t know your symbol or your colors but it seems like perhaps whatever spoke to this tree to take this shape, what your describing, it’s like its speaking in a simler and claeer way that it speak to this tree. I cam to this island and chose to stay away from the machinations of the grand emporium. Given my inclination to trust all of you, I have something to show you.
We return to her hut. She looks at us and gestures to the outcrop that she’s burrowed into. “The rock here is very soft. The weather is lovely, maybe better than anywhere else. When I came here and realized it took very little to make space, I found somethings that have been my labor for some time.” She walks through and gestures us to come in.
Small space, 12 ft across. Interior cliff. Stone is braidable. Scrapiong a rock would shave more stone off. Bed on one side, small hearth. We see older stonework protruding from one stop on the wall. A small hole next to some of the stonework that burrows back into the cliff. She loks adna says “Do you dare follow me.”
We do. [[File:Fresco1.png|thumb|First Fresco in Orm's Cave]] She picks up a candle, lights it. We follow her. She moves quickly. Bright stone. We see stonework protruding out in various places. Hear a hall of sound up ahead. She takes a sharp turn. We follow. We stand up inside a space. We enter a rooma nd it seems like a legitimate room, not like her space. Built by someone with masonry skills, not hollowed out. The ceiling is a bunch of very old woodworking, cracked in places, but still holding whatever is above it. We see by the light of the candle that there are images ont he walls.
[[File:Fresco2.png|thumb|Second Fresco in Orm's Cave]] [[File:Fresco3.png|thumb|Third]] We ruminate on the frescos. They seem to be using bronze tools to create something makde out of bronze. It seems like a record of a way to make a certain thing, something like an offering. They’re wearing jewelry of the same color.
Orm: I find them awe inspiring. Who ever put them here put them here a long time ago. It was buried under stone. How many people have paintings on their wall? And I have these because I found them buried in the side of a hill. Your talking about the color in this simple symbol. It’s work, it’s creation, it’s a small part of something, and I guess I wanted you all to see it. But I don’t know, as you suggested, it looks like metal work to me, but I’m no expert.
We ask about the smoking island.
Orm: It smokes, it smells bad and noting grows there.
Balz: Any plans to do more tunneling.
Orm: I’m only one person. It’s hard work, and I’ve found this, and I shouldn’t ask for toomuch. But I have to assume there must be more out there.
Balz: Anyone else live here?
Orm: Sometimes people stop on their way to Emporium over there. They store things along the shore, but no one really lives here. It looks a little barren, and the wonders of the city are much more attractive to most.
Balz We know the city by a different name.
Orm: I’ve always called it Emporium.
Balz Heard of T-town?
Orm: I have not.
Balz: Ever met any wind basket weavers.
Orm: I have not, but it’d be something I’m interested in.
We mention we’ve looking for a place to stay. She says we have a place if we’re willing to help. She sends us off on various tasks. She makes a stew from a brace of conies. We need our own bowls though.
She was brought to the city when she was young. She became lost, orphaned. Her family left, disappeared. She’s not sure what happened. She was growing upn on he streets, and kept looking out through the various gateways and saw this island when she wa fairly young. She snuck out from that gate and stole a small row boat dinghy and rode out here and made a place for herself. Goes back in once in a while to catch up on t eh news, Still knows a few people ina nd around the palace. Happier to be out here on the island. Generally where she stays.
Balz: Any advice about entering the city?
Orm: The city is full of many people from many different places. Not hard to go unnoticed as long as that is your goal and work towards it. And probably if you would like to spend time in there, it would be in your best interest, to spend time with the less reputable firms shall we say.
Balz: Should we leave our bear with you.
Orm: He would certainly stand out walking around there. Not everyone would think bears as gentle creatures. She references a story that Balz would have hear of a bear monster living in the woods.
She agrees to keep Arthen while we travel to the city.
Balz: Recommendation for a contact?
Orm: When you enter the city, if you make your way to the central park, one of the roads leading off of it leads to a gate out of which tall wild ragged mountains can be seen if you leave through that entrance. By that gate, there’s a small circular temple and a park. I’ve always found the tenders of that space to be willing to listen. I am friendly with them. (She gives us a name to ask for) They may be able to help you.

page.title: 1/9/25 The One Where We Thelma and Louise Over a Waterfall

revision.comment: Created page with "These instruments are akin to Aeolean harps. The tones of them at night were similar to those we’ve heard in the forests, but these ones are more familiar. Balz observes that they would feel that they’re not allies perse but also not enemies. BW especially has got a mischievous streak, a fuck around and find out kind of thing. Balz would not believe that they would actively do us harm, but also won’t stop us from huirting ourselves. A feeling of dark humor. He’s..."
revision.text:
These instruments are akin to Aeolean harps. The tones of them at night were similar to those we’ve heard in the forests, but these ones are more familiar.
Balz observes that they would feel that they’re not allies perse but also not enemies. BW especially has got a mischievous streak, a fuck around and find out kind of thing. Balz would not believe that they would actively do us harm, but also won’t stop us from huirting ourselves. A feeling of dark humor. He’s hinting at things but not being entirely open.
The party discusses what to tell BW and Fiona, regarding the other ways into Nyth. We agree after some debate that we should share that we entered through the prison portal, and that Musk traveled through the cave. Balz describes the prison and the forest.
They are very interested. They look at eachother , They ask how we got to the prison.
We say that we traveled through the funeral pyre and the boatman having directed us.
They confer again. Tell us more.
Branwen shares that that was the moment when she came into being. We tell them the name of the prison.
Then your courage is probably sufficient for the path that I would suggest to you.
What is this path?
Are you finished? Can we offer you wine or song?
Balz: “One more thing,” and lowers his hood. I’ve gotten some looks about my decorative apendages since I’ve been here. Do they mean anything to you>
My you are an intriguing group of individuals, quite a ciollectiuon of oddities. Glance at Balz with horns, a pale woman with hair like a night wind, traveling in the company of a small and great bear.
Bran: What do you know of the bear?
They gesture to Silas and say “He may be small but he has a bear;s shape.” And that is all that can be said about that,
What does he see when he looks at Storr and K?
Storr: You bring with you a fire in the sky. K: You are a hunter of the winds and waters.
He sits back in his chair and smirks with his one crazy eye. “As I said, quite a collection of invdivioduals, the likes of which we have not seen before.”
Can I interest you in a fortifying wine. Storr declines, and the rest imbibe. A thick rich red wine. “Follow us” Koweth takes a beak full before Branwen drinks.
We follow them back down to the tower and through the greenspace. There’s a cleft in some rock. A cherry tree and a copper beech growing on either side of this entrance.
“This would be my suggested path. Are you prepared? Your guide waits just inside.
Storr: We need our armaments.
He smirks and says, “Sure.” and calls to a guard, and they run off to grab them. They return with our affects.
Balz: Any advice before we head in? You don’t recommend going over the falls. Where does this go?
This would be my suggestion. The guide is awaiting you.
Storr gets the sense that Kleghein is frightened but doesn’t want to be so its working itself up to be pumped af.
We walk through and it gets very dark. Ahead of us the cave opens out a little, there’s some movement ahead of us, we walk down and we walk in. We see a spectral dog who looks nervous, spotted black and white, natural athlete, but he is waiting for us in this chamber. He looks at us and barks as if to say “ready?” and starts to sunter down a pathway.
We follow him down, at times we hear voices and shapes of bodies but when we look we see just rock. Can’t tell if we’re really hearing and seeing these things. Mostly we’re able to keep up, but hte re are times when he disappears. We follow by sound. Not sure if he’s lost us, but we keep going down. We’re feeling more and more moisture. A mist comes up the passageway. We find ourselves in an opening, small dome, 15 ft across, 9 ft ceiling, a rough floor we’ve come down to and there’s an opening through which we see darkness, but there’s spray coming through. He sits down and looks at us, sits down and looks almost sad with his eyebrows.
We suspect this might be the black water. Storr unsheaths Klegh and activates the 2nd rune, which sheds moonlight. We see that the floor has an arc that goes through this arc. Still ahrd to see what’s going on, but we do see some lights out there.
Storr approaches the dog with Kl drawn and approaches the edge. As our eyes adjust it seems like we’re seeing night sky, with the constellations that we’ve seen elsewhere, and we sense that we can see the waterfall off to the left of us. We’re on almost a balcony. The dog comes and he sits down next to storr and looks up at her,, looks out, looks back at her, barks, and runs out into the night sky and slowly disappears as he goes.
Storr leaps, and so do we all. We leap off into the night sky. We’re falling through the night sky. We can see the water cascading to our left. We’re moving into the stream. As we fall, we see what we think are enormous black branching shapes through the sky along with gray non descript people moving, sometimes holding hands in groups, looking upwards in a sense of reverence, we fall and join with the water and we fall for a long time.

== Our Yules == === Storr’s “Yule Dream” ===
“''One night as you sleep at Martin’s Summer Farm, you see Beryan - the mother who runs the farm - go off into the woods.  While she is kind and seems warm and friendly, you don’t feel entirely at ease with her, and she watches you in such a way that you feel uncomfortable, and as though she is judging you.  You decide to follow her, and you do so stealthily.  She walks into the forest along a path that you hadn’t really noticed before, and it leads you to a large old tree that sits next to a spring.  It seems as though between the roots there’s a bed of moss and grasses, and she nestles down into it, and stares at the well.  You awake later in the hayloft - where she’s had you sleep - and aren’t sure whether or not the whole thing was a dream''”
=== Branwen's "Yule Observation" ===
''"One afternoon, when there’s a pause in the work of housekeeping, you retire to have tea with the girls by the fire, but realize that you forgot your cloak, and feel like using it as a blanket, because although the sun is warm outside, the brisk autumn winds sweep through the common room.  When you re-enter the kitchen, you hear Gwenynen’s voice speaking to someone, and you peak through the cracked door that enters into her private room.  Perched on her window is a large owl, whom she appears to be talking to.  You withdraw quietly, so as not to be noticed, and ponder what you have seen."''
=== Silas' "Yule Experience" ===
''"The evening after the fight, the blonde girl asks if she can bring Arthen to her room with her. You say yes, and she smiles, and leads him away. As you sleep on the tower’s open roof, you’re woken early in the morning by a sound below you. You peer over the parapet, and you think that you see the blonde girl, along with the black hair girl and the redhead playing the children’s game where the three link hands and spring in a circle. In the middle of the circle Arthen leans against the tree. When you go down there stairs to take a closer look, you find the four girls sitting by the fire. Arthen is curled up on the couch with his head in the blonde girl’s lap."''
== We loot those bodies == What was our impression of the visitors? We got the sense that we were the priority, more than just a normal bureaucratic visit. We loot those bodies. Armor and weapons are all bronze. Fairly heavily armored, scale or plate. Branwen’s looking for armor. (Balz has studded leather and gives it to Branwen) Woman has a torc around her neck made of three metals twisted together (like the ring we have) She has a similar book to the one we found in the captain’s quarters, which Branwen likely recognized as a spellbook (Aug 1st) Ring metals: entwined in three types, not sure what they are. Gale has some decorative metalwork on it. Ring wouldn’t look like the work of the same hand of Gale. Same type of embellishment. Branwen removes the necklace. B feels that the object has some power in the same way as Gale or K. They’re in Bran’s inventory. == Undertakings == Balz: Maps: Has S traveled beyond this area? Ponder star maps as well. Also interested in helping make a telescope secondarily. Undertaking focus will be the maps. Can help glasses to make a telescope, but not After the encounter, Gwen and the folk in the tower.. The girls exchange glances with Gwen, and sort of smiles. G: “Yeah, we’re not too worried about it.” Based on that answer, we agree to take Yule. Potential post-yule infiltration of the SK’s ranks. We start taking their clothing and armor in the interest of disguising ourselves and sneaking into the city. How does the emerging magic play into this? Could we use magic in that way? Maybe the old woman in the forest can manage something? Speak with the dead option? DM: It’s on the table for a discussion, possibly a Branwen abilityx. We talk about inventory. Krambler is still with us. Baz is on the lookout for another hand crossbow. K’s fellowship task could be to craft a new hand crossbow. Or craft M’s helmet in such a way that the helmet could be worn by both Silas and Arthyden. Mannix’s helmet might be a good addition for Arthyden, for charging. It’s made og a goat skull. At Tawesek, we ask the blacksmith to fashion it into something. He asks to use K’s hammer and K has a dream about it. K’s undertaking: He’ll attempt to do something with glasses to make something with her input, either a hand crossbow or adjust something M’s helmet Balz has a buckler made from the turtle shell. '''Group undertaking:''' Study magical items. Storr goes to work on Martins Summer Farm. Meets the family. She is working hard. She feels the burn of the work, pounding iron, takes out some anger and stress. Hurling hay, moving stone to make fences. She gets to know the family, the farmer. A mother and her six children. She integrates into the family. She has an experience in the log. She packs up food and hikes back up to the tower. Sheds a shadow scar. She is no longer miserable. (At the time she became miserable, our fellowship rating was 6. Is it back up to 6 now?) Ballz talks about a proof of circles and equilateral triangles with Glasses, related to the lenses. She’s super excited that she figured this out. (Glasses girl’s proofs) DM will circle back on results of Balz undertaking based on what others manage to accomplish Branwen is SNEAKING. Trying to find out more about the girls. Silas plays a walking song. Bran reads her bit. Gwen was having a conversation with the owl, nothing desperate or fearful, a sense of purpose. There was an owl named Archimedes that was Merlin’s pet. There is also a red fox constellation and there’s a story of a fox outwitting an owl. Maybe there’s an owl constellation that wqe haven’t identified. Is there also a large owl bird that is one og the phoenix and ther goose’s ilk? This owl was large. Guessing, it was 3 or 4 feet tall. Island birds. The story of Bargos. Raven is a sibling of Bargos. All these birds might be siblings, might be proxies for gods. B did hear the owl speaking back, not a human voice, but didn’t hear what it said. Silas’s experience. The children’s circle game. Silas was older when he joined the druidic circle. This game coils represent a ritual of sorts like children’s games sometimes do. Over the course of the month, no more emissaries from SK arrived. K isn’t sure why, but he sees the blonde girl especially doing some work around the tower and she seems to be the one, she is the one that fixes it. He feels compelled to lend her his hammer to work on some things. By the end of the month, he feels compelled to give her the hammer. Why? He feels like he wanted to go and complete this task, but now his place is going back to Tawesek and carry on the Abbots legacy there, and return to the mountains that he hears calling him. He sees her fixing things, and he sees her using it better than he, and he gives it to her “in her keeping, to choose its destiny”. Still open for us to take it with us. Balz would like to sketch K’s tattoos before he departs.   Balz is looking for leads about potential new locations that might be a good spot for celestial observation or landmarks that S might know about that are mysterious that might be worth chiecking out. Probably not more than the map of Nyth we already have. Stuff close by, his world doesn’t extend much beyond the tower. You can go up the tower, and down into the valley to Storr’s farm. Has he heard of anyone in Nyth that might have a map of someplace outside of Nyth, a treasured possession that they might not understand? We need to determine what our next step is, and then we can unlock more about Balz interfacing with S. Silas asks the blonde girl about the game, she says it’s called “playing cradle”, the person in the middle is in the cradle and spin around them. Just a gesture, no words. He thought he saw them playing this upon waking. The cradle is also the name of the symbol we found in front of the tree of seasons, which [[8/8/24 The One Where Silas and Balz Contemplate Trees#:~:text=Balz asks Silas if he remembers the symbol at all (21) Silas does remember it. He would have seen it in the henges. Would not have understood it, and would not have been explained. But definitely recognizes it. He thinks his folk called it "the cradle" Was it a part of the ritual?|Silas has also seen in henges in his homeland]]. Silas asks Gwen about the honey. She has hives tucked down near the back entrance of the tower. Some of the bees presumably head down to the forest, other search out alpine plants. Always kind of fascinated by bees and beekeeping. Honey is so nourishing and delicious and loves the process of beekeeping.  Bears don’t come up this far. Only interested in crawling up into a cave. Silas expresses interested in seeing the hives. She does, gross woven skips. Gwen ahsn’t heard of of other sources of honey or bees? Not particularly. == Temperature of who’s our girl == Storr: Blonde Silas: Blonde Bran: Raven Balz: Red head. Tewlder had red hair. Didn’t show any magical ability in the fight. In the haunted tower, ther’s a poem written on the wall (one and one) REREAD THAT == TODOs == * Magical item list * Outcome of Balz’s and Branwen’s undertaking * Other thoughts * Who’s our girl??

page.title: 10/16/23 “The Gang “DOESN’T” Burn Down the House (or how we insulted a group of people without meaning to)”

revision.text:
We enter [[Din Menydh|this encampment]] and notice bear skulls above the gate way. We notice two bears like the ones that attacked us… that are being used respectfully as beasts of burden within the village.
[[Balthazar|Balz]] notices this is similar to the stone circle set up; similar tradition of earth works. Something similar to the sacred grove around Monsoth. It seems old and we may have encountered similar ruins in the old world during collective travel.
We consensually enter through the main gate. The People are surprised at our arrival; children hide behind their parents to look at us. The guard has let us into the gate…
We speak to the guard and ask who’s in charge - [[Henavek (man) & Beryan (woman)|Henavek and Beryan]] are the elders. Their hut is back towards the central square/meeting place. We ask for breakfast and we are told to come to the elders hut and perhaps we’ll see what they have to say.
We are escorted down the main avenue and we see kids, families. The reaction is surprising to the villages - we are strangers, a curiosity. They are all human looking. There’s a few guards up on walls, looking in each direction. People keep an eye but we don’t see a bunch of soldiers. The guards look like village folk who have some training, watching the country. No siege weapons/defenses - spears with stone tips; flint tips. They are just watching.
There’s not a ton of bears, we see a few around that are very large. As tall as a horse, slightly longer. Significant animals. They are treated with a great deal of respect. They are not beasts of burden, they are domesticated but are respected. These are well cared for animals, and receive attention from the folks in the village. The ones we saw were wild animals, healthy but not domestic.
The village has some minor bronze in the tackle for the bears. There’s not an inn or marketplace. Some huts are for storage, some sides or trade but no major commerce. It’s not huge.
We head to the elders, Henavik and Barrian, and ask us to wait outside. We hear some whispering inside - Silas is translating the druidic tongue, they can speak the common language but not so well. It's a broken common tongue - not what they’d converse in primarily. We are invited in but we need to leave our metal stuff… we agree. It's a smokey hut, the elders sit in state… looking at each other and us and say… “Welcome travelers, what brings you here?”
Arthen and the bears check each other out. No issue with Arthen, he enters the hut without any fuss. Of course he’s going to go in and the domesticated bears acknowledged him without much fuss.
Henavek (man) & Beryan (woman) are their names. We thank them for inviting us into their village. They ask us what brings us to the village, and we respond that we seek the source of the black water. They ask us why we are seeking the black water, why are we seeking evil? We relate our tale thus far, from the abbott to our travels and encounters. We tell them that we have met people who have used it as a weapon, and go on to describe our fight with Mali. The elders ask us to leave the hut while they huddle.
The door guard enters the hut, and we hear voices from within. The guard returns, aggressive, and asks us why we bring evil to this village. He says they brought us there in friendship, and we have brought evil into their midst. Storr attempts to quell the fire by stepping in front of the spear; it only angers the guard further. Krambler suggests that we mean them no harm, to which the guard replies, “Explain yourself!” B thinks they might be talking about the black water he carries, but keeps his own counsel. Storr asks why they think we bring evil, and the guard explains that they’ve fought against the black water’s evil for a long time and that we come seeking it out. Storr goes on to explain that we meant no offense; we just want to know what it is so we can fight it, too. This seems to calm the guard, and presently the elders appear in the doorway. They ask us what brought us here? We had mentioned the black water initially, and that caused them to react negatively. The idea of following or using the black water is anathema to their society. They are open to the party explaining themselves further and await our response. They recognize that Silas could be a friend, but they remain wary.
Storr calmly explains that we were tasked with investigating the source and nature of the black water, in order to prevent its use for evil. As we were following the water, we encountered their village by chance and, given our long journey and strange encounters, we sought shelter and information within its walls. Storr asks the nature of the evil; the elders do not know exactly, but know it is ancient and unleashed a terror on the world long ago. They have stood watch for long ages trying to cleave to the ideals of a power that can oppose this evil. As long as they can recall, the black stream has been there. What is the terror they mention? Long ago evil was released and created chaos, and the village was destroyed along with many other things, and a great darkness came. B asks for the source of the black water. They respond that it comes from the Black Lake, high in the mountains. K asks about these powers that can stand up to the evil; they say they are servants of the Great Bear, and they have tried to keep the faith. Have they seen this Great Bear? No, no one has seen the Bear since he went to sleep long, long ago. They pray for His awakening. What is the nature of the Bear? What does he look like? He is giant (they say without qualification), old and strong beyond reckoning. S asks if they ever venture out into the surrounding lands? Are there others like them nearby? They say there are enclaves in this forest, many are secretive. The center of their community is a day or two’s march north along the western bank of the river. They are adept at hiding, though, and there is a splinter sect that lives off to the east that has never come this far (over the mountains), but now and then some travel between the two villages, maintaining a connection. Have they encountered any strange creatures in the forest? They say no, but there are many strange creatures in this forest; its roots go back to the beginning of the world.
It occurs to us that the description of the forest is reminiscent of the dreams we’ve all been having of late. K wonders whether this village is a dream, and “perceives” very confidently that this village is “the real world”.
Silas doesn’t recall having visitors from other sects…they were fairly secluded from the outside. Perhaps the visits to the splinter sect to the east were unbeknownst to Silas…or they occurred before Silas’ time. Silas asks the elders about being called, “Arthyden.” The elders ask, “You’re bear-born?” Silas confirms this, and shares it’s been a point of contention with his bears. Silas explains that he can shapeshift into bear form. The elders suggest we head back to the roundhouse while they meet and confer. What’s up with the bears in your village? These bears are trained, part of our culture, respected and such, seen more as partners, as opposed to domesticated horses as servants.
